subject: Rename memory → johnny: Update all documentation and existing episodes
description:
Update all documentation, comments, references, and existing Graphiti episodes from "memory" to "Johnny".

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/) + Graphiti episodes

**Skills:** Use `/neo4j-cypher-guide` for Graphiti queries.

**Scope:**
- Update docstrings in all johnny service files
- Update API documentation
- Update CLAUDE.md references
- Update any README or docs files
- Update code comments
- Update error messages
- **Search and update existing memory episodes in Graphiti that reference "memory system"**

**Episode Updates:**
- Search Graphiti for episodes containing "memory system", "memory service", "memory API"
- Update episode content to reference "Johnny" instead
- Re-index updated episodes if needed
- Verify episode references still work

**Files:**
- All ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/** files (docstrings)
- All ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/**johnny** files (comments)
- docs/** (if any memory docs exist)
- CLAUDE.md files
- Any markdown documentation
- Graphiti episodes (via API/CLI)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All docstrings updated
- [ ] All comments updated
- [ ] Error messages updated
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] **Existing Graphiti episodes searched for "memory" references**
- [ ] **Relevant episodes updated to use "Johnny" naming**
- [ ] No remaining "memory" references (except Graphiti internals)
- [ ] `dt --check` passes

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
